time_note: All durations are indicative wall-time ranges. They exclude queueing, environment setup, manual review, and experimental work; CPU/GPU availability and system size can change them substantially.

methods.title: Transition-state and electrostatic tuning
methods.boundary: QM/MM supports a computational reaction-path inference, not experimental validation.

methods.title: Proton or hydrogen-transfer diagnosis
methods.boundary: Do not infer tunnelling from donor-acceptor distance alone.

methods.title: Metal and cofactor environment review
methods.boundary: First-shell metal ligands are protected by default.

methods.title: Pocket interaction and selectivity review
methods.boundary: Docking and contact fingerprints do not prove binding affinity or selectivity.

methods.title: Tunnel and gate review
methods.boundary: Geometric tunnels are not kinetic rate constants.

methods.title: Preorganization and conformational dynamics
methods.estimate: quick: 6–48 GPU hours or 1–7 CPU days; standard: 1–7 GPU days
methods.boundary: Classical MD cannot supply a chemical activation barrier.

methods.title: Allosteric-network hypothesis
methods.boundary: MSM/metadynamics are only interpretable after convergence assessment.

methods.title: Stability and environmental tolerance
methods.estimate: static review: 10–30 minutes; Rosetta screening: 2–24 CPU hours per about 10 sites
methods.boundary: Predicted ΔΔG is a ranking proxy, not Tm or half-life.

methods.title: Water-network and solvent-interface hypothesis
methods.boundary: A water-bridge observation is not a hydration free-energy measurement.

methods.title: Expression, aggregation, consensus and interface review
methods.estimate: 10–30 minutes for advice; 2–24 CPU hours for structural screening
methods.boundary: Consensus frequency ignores epistasis and never overrides protected functional sites.
